about_the_game:
Redhowl is a top-down social deduction game that immerses you in the world of Little Red Riding Hood. Developed by the independent studio BENOM STUDIO, it’s an online multiplayer game for 4 to 15 players.

You’ll find yourself in Grandmother’s village, deep within the Redhowl forest. Far from the idyllic childhood tale… Take on multiple roles to uncover within three factions: the Little Hoods, the Wolves, and the Voiceless. Only teamwork and your deduction skills will save the village.

Redhowl alternates between day, night, and council phases. There is also a Blood Moon, a nightmarish variant of the night phase. Each player has powers and objectives unique to their role and faction.

  • During the day, the village thrives by completing daily quests assigned by Grandmother and ensuring everything runs smoothly.

  • At night, the Hoods and Voiceless have limited vision, while the Wolves can transform and devour their prey.

  • At dawn, the village gathers to share observations and deductions. When the council ends, each player votes alone, following their conscience. Then, everyone gathers in the town square to find out whether a player has been executed by the village.

  • Little Hoods Faction : The Hood, the Village Donkey, the Tax Collector, the Falconer, the Medium, the Revenant, the Politician, the Trapper, the Undertaker and the renowned Hunter !

  • Wolves Faction : The Wolf and the Fanatic.

  • Voiceless Faction : The Assassin.

Features :

  • Unique factions and roles

  • Customizable games : plenty of variations to suit your preferences

  • Cosmetics : colors and skins

  • Proximity voice chat

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • Storage: 5000 MB available space

short_description: Redhowl is an online social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. Take on various roles across 3 factions. Switch between day, night, and councils to investigate, cooperate, or deceive to save (or destroy) Grandmother’s village.
